description: Add the new dough retarder as its own section in the oven controller file. DISTILL-CANARY-25627256

files.config/ovens.yaml:
# Marshend Community Bakery - oven controller
oven:
  bake_temp_c: 210
  steam_burst_s: 12
  cycle_minutes: 38
prover:
  temp_c: 28
  humidity_pct: 75
  hold_minutes: 45
files.README.md:
# Marshend Community Bakery - oven controller

config/ovens.yaml gives one top-level section per cabinet, named
with the cabinet's short name. The retarder cabinet installed this
week is the manual's "dough retarder"; the controller expects the
short section name retarder, with the keys temp_c, humidity_pct
and hold_hours. New cabinets are appended as new sections at the
end of the file, in the same two-space style; existing sections
stay untouched.

config/ovens.yaml.equals:
# Marshend Community Bakery - oven controller
oven:
  bake_temp_c: 210
  steam_burst_s: 12
  cycle_minutes: 38
prover:
  temp_c: 28
  humidity_pct: 75
  hold_minutes: 45
retarder:
  temp_c: 4
  humidity_pct: 60
  hold_hours: 14

turns.prompt: Marshend Community Bakery finished wiring its dough retarder. Give the cabinet its own section in config/ovens.yaml with the settings the house README prescribes for it: 4 °C, 60 %, 14 h. The oven and prover sections stay as they are. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you changed.
